title: The Signature Edge Case Solved Database — Solved: last_verified Without a Timezone Is Ambiguous
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Resolution: Solved: last_verified Without a Timezone Is Ambiguous. Root cause: Date-only stamps ("2026-10-21") parse as UTC midnight; verifiers west of UTC read the previous day, so audit days disagreed. Fix: Stamp full ISO-8601 with timezone (or UTC "Z"). title: The Signature Edge Case Solved Database — Solved: Generator Seed 0 Treated as "No Seed"
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Resolution: Solved: Generator Seed 0 Treated as "No Seed". Root cause: Arg parsing used "seed = args.seed || DEFAULT"; 0 is falsy, so --seed 0 silently became the default seed and the "reproducible" run was not the requested one. Fix: Use nullish checks: seed = (args.seed ?? DEFAULT). Only undefined/null fall back; 0 is honored. Verification: 1) --seed 0 -> 0. 2) absent seed -> default. 3) Both runs reproducible. How to run: save the fix program as fix.js and run: node fix.js. It replays the edge scenario with the fix applied, prints a FIXED line, and asserts the corrected behavior.
